layout.fallback: If the button does not open, copy this link into your browser's address bar:
layout.footer_auto: This is an automated message, please do not reply.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email
verify_email.preheader: Confirm your address to finish signing up for the Studio.
verify_email.title: Confirm your email address
verify_email.lead: One step left: confirm that this address is yours and your Studio account will be ready.
context: The address {email} was used to sign up on the server {server}.
security: If you did not sign up, just ignore this message: without confirmation the account will not become active.

reset_password.subject: Password reset
reset_password.preheader: A link to set a new password in the Studio.
reset_password.title: Password reset
reset_password.lead: We received a request to change your password. Press the button to set a new one.
context: A password reset for {email} was requested on the server {server}.
security: If you did not ask for a reset, ignore this message: your password stays the same.
Do not forward this email: the link in it can change your password.

invite.subject: Invitation to the Studio
invite.preheader: You are invited to sign up for the Studio.
invite.title: You are invited to the Studio
invite.lead: You are invited to the Studio. Press the button to sign up.
invite.lead_by: {inviter} invites you to the Studio. Press the button to sign up.
context: The invitation was sent to {email}: use this address to sign up on the server {server}.
security: If you did not expect this invitation, just ignore this message.

email_change.subject: Confirm your new email
email_change.preheader: Confirm that this address can be attached to your account.
email_change.title: Confirm your new address
email_change.lead: You asked to attach this address to your Studio account. Press the button to confirm the change.
context: The address change was requested in an account on the server {server}.
security: If you did not change your address, ignore this message: the account stays on its previous address. If the message is unexpected, change your password.

reset_notice.subject: An administrator issued a password reset link
reset_notice.preheader: A password reset link was created for your account.
reset_notice.title: A password reset link was issued
reset_notice.lead: A Studio administrator created a password reset link for your account.
context: The link went to the administrator, not to you: they will pass it on themselves. This email was sent to {email}, server {server}.
security: If you did not ask for it, contact the administrator.

passkey_added.subject: A passkey was added
passkey_added.preheader: A new sign-in key was added to your account.
passkey_added.title: A new passkey was added
passkey_added.lead: A passkey “{name}” was added to your Studio account.
context: We report every new sign-in key so that you can spot one you did not add. Account: {email}, server {server}.
security: If it wasn't you, remove the key in your account settings (Passkeys) and change your password.

passkey_reset.subject: An administrator reset your passkeys
passkey_reset.preheader: All passkeys of your account were removed.
passkey_reset.title: Passkeys were reset
passkey_reset.lead: A Studio administrator removed all passkeys of your account.
context: You can sign in with your password or single sign-on and add a new passkey in your account settings. Account: {email}, server {server}.
security: If you did not ask for it, contact the administrator.

project_invitation.subject: {actor} invites you to “{project}”
project_invitation.preheader: Accept or decline the invitation in your Inbox.
project_invitation.title: Project invitation
project_invitation.lead: {actor} invites you to the project “{project}” as {role}.
context: The invitation came to {email}, which is attached to your account on the server {server}.
security: If you did not expect this invitation, just ignore this message or decline it in your Inbox.

project_invitation_link.subject: {actor} invites you to “{project}”
project_invitation_link.preheader: Open the link to accept the project invitation.
project_invitation_link.title: Project invitation
project_invitation_link.lead: {actor} invites you to the project “{project}” in the Studio as {role}.
context: Open the link and sign in or sign up with {email}: the invitation is bound to this address. Server {server}.
security: If you did not expect this invitation, just ignore this message.

access_request.subject: {actor} requests access to “{project}”
access_request.preheader: Approve or deny the request in your Inbox.
access_request.title: Project access request
context: You received this email because you can manage access to the project on the server {server}.
security: If you do not know this person, deny the request in your Inbox: access will not open without your decision.

transfer_request.subject: {actor} is transferring “{project}” to you
transfer_request.preheader: Accept or decline the transfer in your Inbox.
transfer_request.title: Project transfer
transfer_request.lead: {actor} is transferring the project “{project}” to you. Once you accept, you become its owner.
context: The transfer is addressed to your account on the server {server}.
security: If you did not expect the transfer, decline it in your Inbox: until you accept, the current owner stays the owner.

signing_request.subject: {actor} asks you to sign: {profile}
signing_request.preheader: The signing page shows only your documents and the places for your signature.
signing_request.title: Documents to sign
signing_request.lead: {actor} asks you to sign the documents “{profile}” in the project “{project}”.
context: You are on the signing route of a project on the server {server}. This email was sent to {email}.
security: The signing page opens only after you sign in to your account: a forwarded email does not let anyone sign for you.

signing_request_sign.subject: Sign the final PDF: {profile}
signing_request_sign.preheader: The documents are frozen, only your electronic signature is left.
signing_request_sign.title: Sign the final PDF
signing_request_sign.lead: The documents “{profile}” in the project “{project}” are frozen. Only your electronic signature on the final PDF is left.
context: You are on the signing route of a project on the server {server}. This email was sent to {email}.
security: The signing page opens only after you sign in to your account: a forwarded email does not let anyone sign for you.

signing_reminder.subject: Reminder: {profile}
signing_reminder.preheader: The documents are waiting for your signature.
signing_reminder.title: Documents are waiting for your signature
signing_reminder.lead: The documents “{profile}” in the project “{project}” are still waiting for your signature.
context: You are on the signing route of a project on the server {server}. This email was sent to {email}.
security: The signing page opens only after you sign in to your account: a forwarded email does not let anyone sign for you.

signing_returned.subject: {actor} returned the documents for revision
signing_returned.preheader: The signing route is stopped: read the comment and send the documents again.
signing_returned.title: Documents returned for revision
signing_returned.lead: {actor} returned the documents of the project “{project}” for revision. The signing route is stopped.
context: You sent these documents for signing on the server {server}. This email was sent to {email}.

signing_completed.subject: Everyone has signed: {profile}
signing_completed.preheader: All signatures are in, you can build the submission package.
signing_completed.title: Documents signed
signing_completed.lead: All route participants signed the documents “{profile}” in the project “{project}”. You can build the package now.
context: You sent these documents for signing on the server {server}. This email was sent to {email}.

smtp_test.subject: HSE Doc Studio: mail check
smtp_test.preheader: This is a test message: mail sending is set up correctly.
smtp_test.title: Mail is set up
smtp_test.lead: This is a test message from the Studio. If you can read it, mail sending works.
context: An administrator sent this test message from the Mail section on the server {server}.
